Package com.epitech.depthdiablo.arena

Class ArenaCycle

java.lang.Object
com.epitech.depthdiablo.arena.ArenaCycle
All Implemented Interfaces:
Rewindable
public final class ArenaCycle extends Object implements Rewindable
An arena cycle consists of waves with breaks between them, ending in a boss wave followed by a shop, and tracks the number of waves defeated as the score. It is in the rewind photo (R): a rewind puts back the wave, the phase, the break timer and the score with the world.

      public ArenaCycle(int wavesPerCycle, int breakTicks)
      Creates a new arena cycle whose boss wave opens the shop.
      Parameters:
      wavesPerCycle - the number of normal waves in the cycle + 1 boss wave
      breakTicks - the number of ticks spent between two normal waves
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if a provided value is lower than 1

    • ArenaCycle

      public ArenaCycle(int wavesPerCycle, int breakTicks, boolean shopEnabled)
      Creates a new arena cycle.
      Parameters:
      wavesPerCycle - the number of normal waves in the cycle + 1 boss wave
      breakTicks - the number of ticks spent between two waves
      shopEnabled - false: a cleared boss wave starts a break like any wave, no shop
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if a provided value is lower than 1
